title: Otumfoɔ a Ɔhwehwɛɛ Nyamesu
intro: Sodifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi na ɔyɛ ahantan gye dii sɛ obiara nnyina wɔn ahengua no atifi. Wɔtaa kuw bi a wɔreguan faa nsu kɛse bi mu, na wohyiaa awiei a ɛyɛ nwonwa. Saa ɔhene yi asɛm no ka wɔ Kur’aan no nkyekyɛmu pii mu, na ɛyɛ kɔkɔbɔ ma obiara.
clues: Ná meyɛ sodifo a ɔwɔ tumi a na migye di sɛ tumi biara nni hɔ a ɛboro m’ankasa de so wɔ nsase a midi so no so.
Ná mewɔ ɔsraani panyin bi a megye me di a wɔfrɛ no Haman a ɔboaa me ma meyɛɛ adansi adwuma akɛse.
Mefrɛɛ m’asase so nkonyaayifo a wɔsen biara sɛ wɔmmɛkasa tia ɔbɔfo bi a ɔsɔre tia me no nsɛnkyerɛnne.
Mepowee sɛ mɛma nkurɔfo bi a wɔayɛ wɔn nkoa wɔ m’ahemman mu no afi hɔ, ɛmfa ho ɔhaw ne kɔkɔbɔ a emu da hɔ no.
Mede m’asraafo ne nteaseɛnam nyinaa dii wɔn akyi twaa po kɛse bi.
Saa po no ara too me ne m’asraafo so, na ɛmenee yɛn nyinaa, bere a na wɔretwa dwoodwoo no.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Ɔhaw ahorow ne akasakasa a wɔne Musa (Mose) dii .
Wɔresi adaka ansa na nsuyiri kɛse bi aba
Ɔko ne Jalut wɔ bon no mu
Aguadi mu duru a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban
trial.answer: Ɔhaw ahorow ne akasakasa a wɔne Musa (Mose) dii .

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
